title: Anyone have dreams about an auditorium?
content: Most of my recurring dreams involve the mall/resort hub. Sometimes it’s my old high school or neighborhood. Lots of traveling themes going on. Elevators or stairways and going into old classrooms and trying to find an open seat. Driving on the highway and looking up. Being at the beach and seeing the “tower” Supermarket or lunch line comes next. Or the weird shower pod/locker room. Then there’s the giant auditorium. I’m usually near the balcony. I think it’s a movie theater? Blue and light blue. Wooden floors. You’re all there with me. . . Sorry this is so “stream of consciousness” it helps me remember. Any thoughts?
